description: Awarding the Contract for Maintenance, Repair and Organization (MRO) to overhaul Honeywell Auxiliary Power Units (APUs) for SriLankan Airlines
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-06 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Commercial aircraft use Honeywell Auxiliary Power Units (APUs) to provide essential power and pneumatic support when the main engines of the aircraft are not operating. Since SriLankan Airlines Limited does not have in-house capacity to off-wing maintenance on these APUs, bids have been invited under the Limited International Competitive Bidding procedure for the procurement of related repair and maintenance services. 06 bids have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Ports and Civil Aviation to award the said contract to HONEYWELL INTERNATIONAL INC. Aerospace, the substantially responsive lowest bidder, for a period of 05 years at a sum of US$25.17 million, taking into account the recommendation submitted by the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, after evaluating the said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.
